title: Build WITH PRINT printing service website with PhonePe payment

requirements.text: Create a home page displaying business name 'WITH PRINT' prominently at the top
acceptanceCriteria: Business name 'WITH PRINT' is displayed prominently on the home page

requirements.text: Display pricing table on home page showing B&W printing at ₹1 per page and color printing at ₹10 per page
acceptanceCriteria: Pricing table shows B&W printing at ₹1 per page
Pricing table shows color printing at ₹10 per page
Pricing information is clearly visible and formatted

requirements.text: Add delivery information section to home page stating delivery timeline
acceptanceCriteria: Delivery information is displayed on home page
Delivery timeline is clearly communicated

requirements.text: Display contact phone number with call timing information on home page
acceptanceCriteria: Phone number is displayed on home page
Call timings are shown alongside phone number

requirements.text: Add 'Proceed to Payment' button on home page that navigates to payment page
acceptanceCriteria: Button labeled 'Proceed to Payment' is visible on home page
Clicking button navigates user to payment page

requirements.text: Create payment page displaying PhonePe QR code image for scanning

quotes: Show your QR code image here

acceptanceCriteria: Payment page displays QR code image prominently
QR code is scannable by payment apps

requirements.text: Display UPI ID '9392673014@axl' and name 'Kairamkonda Upendra Devi' on payment page
acceptanceCriteria: UPI ID '9392673014@axl' is displayed clearly
Name 'Kairamkonda Upendra Devi' is shown on payment page

requirements.text: Add step-by-step payment instructions on payment page: (1) Open PhonePe/Google Pay/Paytm, (2) Scan QR code, (3) Enter amount, (4) Complete payment, (5) Take screenshot, (6) Fill form

quotes:
1. Open PhonePe / Google Pay / Paytm
2. Scan the QR code
3. Enter the total amount
4. Complete payment
5. Take screenshot
6. Fill the form below

acceptanceCriteria: All 6 payment steps are displayed in order
Instructions are clear and easy to follow

requirements.text: Create payment confirmation form with fields: Name (text input), Email (email input), Phone Number (tel input), UTR/Transaction ID (text input), Payment Screenshot (file upload)
acceptanceCriteria: Form contains Name field (text input)
Form contains Email field (email input)
Form contains Phone Number field (tel input)
Form contains UTR/Transaction ID field (text input)
Form contains Payment Screenshot upload field (file input)
All fields are properly labeled

requirements.text: Add blue-colored Submit button to payment confirmation form
acceptanceCriteria: Submit button is blue in color
Button is clearly labeled as 'Submit' or 'Submit Confirmation'

requirements.text: Store payment confirmation data (name, email, phone, UTR, screenshot reference) in backend when form is submitted
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores customer name
Backend stores customer email
Backend stores phone number
Backend stores UTR/transaction ID
Backend stores reference to uploaded screenshot
Data is persisted across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Display success message after form submission: '✅ Payment received successfully. We will verify and start printing. You will get delivery tomorrow morning.'

quotes:
✅ Payment received successfully
We will verify and start printing.
You will get delivery tomorrow morning.

acceptanceCriteria: Success message appears after form submission
Message includes checkmark emoji
Message states 'Payment received successfully'
Message mentions verification and printing will start
Message confirms delivery tomorrow morning

requirements.text: Implement routing for 2-page structure: home page (/) and payment page (/payment)
acceptanceCriteria: Home page accessible at root route
Payment page accessible at /payment route
Navigation between pages works correctly

requirements.text: Apply a clean, professional design theme with a modern, trustworthy aesthetic suitable for a college printing service. Use warm, approachable colors (avoid blue & purple unless in small accents). Ensure consistent typography, adequate spacing, and clear visual hierarchy across both pages.
acceptanceCriteria: Design feels professional and trustworthy
Color scheme is warm and approachable
Typography is consistent across pages
Layout has clear visual hierarchy
Design is suitable for college student audience

constraints: Must be exactly 2 pages: home page and payment page
Payment recipient name must be Kairamkonda Upendra Devi
Submit button must be blue colored
nonGoals: Payment gateway integration or automated payment verification

required: PhonePe payment QR code for UPI ID 9392673014@axl (phonepe-qr.dim_400x400.png)
